title: पञ्चदशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 115 · Bhishma on the bed of arrows

summary.en: Dhritarashtra asks how the army fared without Bhishma, and Sanjaya describes the Pandavas' joy and the Kauravas' grief. Bhishma refuses soft pillows and asks Arjuna for a pillow of arrows, which Arjuna supplies, and Krishna praises him.
summary.kn: ಭೀಷ್ಮನಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಏನೆಂದು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಪಾಂಡವರ ಸಂತೋಷ, ಕೌರವರ ದುಃಖವನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯ ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮೃದು ದಿಂಬುಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿ ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಅರ್ಜುನನಿಂದ ಬಾಣದ ದಿಂಬು ಮತ್ತು ನೀರನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅರ್ಜುನ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಭೇದಿಸಿ ನೀರಿನ ಬುಗ್ಗೆ ಉಕ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र पूछते हैं कि भीष्म के बिना सेना का क्या हुआ, और संजय पाण्डवों का हर्ष और कौरवों का शोक बताते हैं। भीष्म कोमल तकिए अस्वीकार कर अर्जुन से बाणों का तकिया और जल माँगते हैं, और अर्जुन भूमि भेदकर जलधारा उनके मुख तक पहुँचाते हैं।
summary.te: భీష్ముడు లేని సేన స్థితి ఏమని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు అడుగుతాడు; పాండవుల ఆనందం, కౌరవుల శోకాన్ని సంజయుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు. మెత్తని తలగడలను తిరస్కరించి భీష్ముడు అర్జునుని బాణాల తలగడ, నీరు అడుగుతాడు; అర్జునుడు భూమిని ఛేదించి జలధారను ఆయన నోటికి అందిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: பீஷ்மர் இன்றி படை என்ன ஆனது என்று த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்கிறான்; பாண்டவரின் மகிழ்ச்சியையும் கௌரவரின் துயரையும் சஞ்சயன் கூறுகிறான். மென்மையான தலையணைகளை மறுத்த பீஷ்மர் அர்ஜுனனிடம் அம்புத் தலையணையும் நீரும் கேட்க, அர்ஜுனன் பூமியைப் பிளந்து நீரூற்றை அவர் வாய்க்குக் கொண்டுவருகிறான்.
summary.ml: ഭീഷ്മരില്ലാതെ സേന എങ്ങനെ കഴിഞ്ഞു എന്ന് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; പാണ്ഡവരുടെ സന്തോഷവും കൗരവരുടെ ദുഃഖവും സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. മൃദുവായ തലയണ വേണ്ടെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; അർജുനൻ അമ്പുകൾകൊണ്ട് ഒരു തലയണ നൽകുന്നു; കൃഷ്ണൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ പ്രശംസിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.115; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
कथमासंस्तदा योधा हीना भीष्मेण संजय ।
बलिना देवकल्पेन गुर्वर्थे ब्रह्मचारिणा ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, how did the warriors stand then, deprived of Bhishma, the strong, godlike celibate who had taken his vow for his father's sake?

verses.text:
तदैव निहतान्मन्ये कुरूनन्यांश्च पार्थिवान् ।
न प्राहरद्यदा भीष्मो घृणित्वाद्द्रुपदात्मजे ॥

meaning.en: I think the Kurus and the other kings were as good as dead the moment Bhishma, out of pity, would not strike the son of Drupada.

verses.text:
ततो दुःखतरं मन्ये किमन्यत्प्रभविष्यति ।
यदद्य पितरं श्रुत्वा निहतं मम दुर्मतेः ॥

meaning.en: What could bring greater sorrow than that I, an evil-minded man, now hear my father slain?

verses.text:
अश्मसारमयं नूनं हृदयं मम संजय ।
श्रुत्वा विनिहतं भीष्मं शतधा यन्न दीर्यते ॥

meaning.en: Surely my heart is made of solid stone, Sanjaya, since it does not break into a hundred pieces on hearing that Bhishma is slain.

verses.text:
पुनः पुनर्न मृष्यामि हतं देवव्रतं रणे ।
न हतो जामदग्न्येन दिव्यैरस्त्रैः स्म यः पुरा ॥

meaning.en: Again and again I cannot bear that Devavrata was killed in the battle, he whom Rama, son of Jamadagni, with his divine weapons once could not kill.

verses.text:
यदद्य निहतेनाजौ भीष्मेण जयमिच्छता ।
चेष्टितं नरसिंहेन तन्मे कथय संजय ॥

meaning.en: Tell me, Sanjaya, what that lion among men did in the battle today, as he, wishing for victory, was struck down.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
सायाह्ने न्यपतद्भूमौ धार्तराष्ट्रान्विषादयन् ।
पाञ्चालानां ददद्धर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः ॥

meaning.en: In the evening the grandsire, the elder of the Kurus, fell to the ground, casting down the sons of Dhritarashtra and giving joy to the Panchalas.

verses.text:
स शेते शरतल्पस्थो मेदिनीमस्पृशंस्तदा ।
भीष्मो रथात्प्रपतितः प्रच्युतो धरणीतले ॥

meaning.en: Fallen from his chariot, Bhishma lay on his bed of arrows without touching the earth, though he had dropped to the ground.

verses.text:
हा हेति तुमुलः शब्दो भूतानां समपद्यत ।
सीमावृक्षे निपतिते कुरूणां समितिक्षये ॥

meaning.en: A tumultuous cry of "Alas!" rose from all beings when that boundary tree fell in the slaughter of the Kurus.

verses.text:
उभयोः सेनयो राजन्क्षत्रियान्भयमाविशत् ।
भीष्मं शंतनवं दृष्ट्वा विशीर्णकवचध्वजम् ।
कुरवः पर्यवर्तन्त पाण्डवाश्च विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: Fear entered the kshatriyas of both armies, king, on seeing Bhishma, son of Shantanu, with his armor and banner shattered. The Kurus and the Pandavas, lord of the people, drew together around him.

verses.text:
खं तमोवृतमासीच्च नासीद्भानुमतः प्रभा ।
ररास पृथिवी चैव भीष्मे शांतनवे हते ॥

meaning.en: The sky was veiled in darkness, the sun lost its light, and the earth cried out when Bhishma, son of Shantanu, was struck down.

verses.text:
अयं ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो अयं ब्रह्मविदां गतिः ।
इत्यभाषन्त भूतानि शयानं भरतर्षभम् ॥

meaning.en: "This is the best of those who know Brahman; this is the refuge of those who know Brahman," said the beings of the bull of the Bharatas as he lay there.

verses.text:
अयं पितरमाज्ञाय कामार्तं शंतनुं पुरा ।
ऊर्ध्वरेतसमात्मानं चकार पुरुषर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: "This is he who, long ago, knowing that his father Shantanu was sick with desire, made himself a celibate for life, this best of men."

verses.text:
इति स्म शरतल्पस्थं भरतानाममध्यमम् ।
ऋषयः पर्यधावन्त सहिताः सिद्धचारणैः ॥

meaning.en: So the seers, together with perfected beings and bards, hurried around the middle one of the Bharatas as he lay on the bed of arrows.

verses.text:
हते शांतनवे भीष्मे भरतानां पितामहे ।
न किंचित्प्रत्यपद्यन्त पुत्रास्तव च भारत ॥

meaning.en: When Bhishma, son of Shantanu, grandsire of the Bharatas, was killed, your sons, Bharata, could think of nothing to do.

verses.text:
विवर्णवदनाश्चासन्गतश्रीकाश्च भारत ।
अतिष्ठन्व्रीडिताश्चैव ह्रिया युक्ता ह्यधोमुखाः ॥

meaning.en: Their faces were pale and their splendor gone; they stood ashamed, heads bowed in shame.

verses.text:
पाण्डवाश्च जयं लब्ध्वा संग्रामशिरसि स्थिताः ।
सर्वे दध्मुर्महाशङ्खान्हेमजालपरिष्कृतान् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas, having won the victory and standing at the head of the battle, all blew their great conches covered with golden netting.

verses.text:
भृशं तूर्यनिनादेषु वाद्यमानेषु चानघ ।
अपश्याम रणे राजन्भीमसेनं महाबलम् ।
आक्रीडमानं कौन्तेयं हर्षेण महता युतम् ॥

meaning.en: While the trumpets sounded loudly and instruments were played, blameless king, we saw mighty Bhimasena, son of Kunti, leaping about in great joy.

verses.text:
निहत्य समरे शत्रून्महाबलसमन्वितान् ।
संमोहश्चापि तुमुलः कुरूणामभवत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Having killed his powerful enemies in the battle, he exulted, while a tumult of bewilderment came over the Kurus.

verses.text:
कर्णदुर्योधनौ चापि निःश्वसेतां मुहुर्मुहुः ।
तथा निपतिते भीष्मे कौरवाणां धुरंधरे ।
हाहाकारमभूत्सर्वं निर्मर्यादमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Karna and Duryodhana sighed again and again. When Bhishma, bearer of the Kauravas' burden, fell, all went into cries of woe and no restraint remained.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा च पतितं भीष्मं पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव ।
उत्तमं जवमास्थाय द्रोणानीकं समाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhishma fallen, your son Duhshasana, at his best speed, ran to the division of Drona.

verses.text:
भ्रात्रा प्रस्थापितो वीरः स्वेनानीकेन दंशितः ।
प्रययौ पुरुषव्याघ्रः स्वसैन्यमभिचोदयन् ॥

meaning.en: Sent by his brother, that hero, a tiger among men, armored and with his own division, went urging on his troops.

verses.text:
तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य कुरवः पर्यवारयन् ।
दुःशासनं महाराज किमयं वक्ष्यतीति वै ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him come, the Kurus surrounded Duhshasana, great king, wondering what he would say.

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणाय निहतं भीष्ममाचष्ट कौरवः ।
द्रोणस्तदप्रियं श्रुत्वा सहसा न्यपतद्रथात् ॥

meaning.en: Then the Kaurava told Drona that Bhishma was slain. Hearing that unwelcome news, Drona suddenly fell from his chariot.

verses.text:
स संज्ञामुपलभ्याथ भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ।
निवारयामास तदा स्वान्यनीकानि मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Recovering his senses, the mighty son of Bharadvaja, respected sir, then held back his own divisions.

verses.text:
विनिवृत्तान्कुरून्दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवापि स्वसैनिकान् ।
दूतैः शीघ्राश्वसंयुक्तैरवहारमकारयन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Kurus withdrawn, the Pandavas also had their soldiers recalled by messengers on swift horses.

verses.text:
विनिवृत्तेषु सैन्येषु पारंपर्येण सर्वशः ।
विमुक्तकवचाः सर्वे भीष्ममीयुर्नराधिपाः ॥

meaning.en: As the armies withdrew one after another from every side, the kings all took off their armor and went to Bhishma.

verses.text:
व्युपारम्य ततो युद्धाद्योधाः शतसहस्रशः ।
उपतस्थुर्महात्मानं प्रजापतिमिवामराः ॥

meaning.en: Stopping the fight, the warriors by hundreds of thousands stood before the great-souled man as the immortals stand before Prajapati.

verses.text:
ते तु भीष्मं समासाद्य शयानं भरतर्षभम् ।
अभिवाद्य व्यतिष्ठन्त पाण्डवाः कुरुभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: Reaching Bhishma, bull of the Bharatas, as he lay there, the Pandavas with the Kurus greeted him and stood by.

verses.text:
अथ पाण्डून्कुरूंश्चैव प्रणिपत्याग्रतः स्थितान् ।
अभ्यभाषत धर्मात्मा भीष्मः शांतनवस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Then, as the Pandavas and Kurus bowed and stood before him, the righteous Bhishma, son of Shantanu, spoke.

verses.text:
स्वागतं वो महाभागाः स्वागतं वो महारथाः ।
तुष्यामि दर्शनाच्चाहं युष्माकममरोपमाः ॥

meaning.en: "Welcome to you, fortunate ones, welcome, great warriors! I am pleased to see you, who are like the immortals."

verses.text:
अभिनन्द्य स तानेवं शिरसा लम्बताब्रवीत् ।
शिरो मे लम्बतेऽत्यर्थमुपधानं प्रदीयताम् ॥

meaning.en: Having welcomed them, he said, with his head hanging down, "My head hangs very low. Give me a pillow."

verses.text:
ततो नृपाः समाजह्रुस्तनूनि च मृदूनि च ।
उपधानानि मुख्यानि नैच्छत्तानि पितामहः ॥

meaning.en: Then the kings brought fine, soft pillows, but the grandsire did not want them.

verses.text:
अब्रवीच्च नरव्याघ्रः प्रहसन्निव तान्नृपान् ।
नैतानि वीरशय्यासु युक्तरूपाणि पार्थिवाः ॥

meaning.en: Smiling a little, the tiger among men said to those kings, "These are not fit for a hero's bed, lords of earth."

verses.text:
ततो वीक्ष्य नरश्रेष्ठमभ्यभाषत पाण्डवम् ।
धनंजयं दीर्घबाहुं सर्वलोकमहारथम् ॥

meaning.en: Then he looked at the best of men, the Pandava Dhananjaya, long-armed, a great warrior in all the world, and said:

verses.text:
धनंजय महाबाहो शिरसो मेऽस्य लम्बतः ।
दीयतामुपधानं वै यद्युक्तमिह मन्यसे ॥

meaning.en: "Dhananjaya, mighty-armed, my head hangs down. Give me a pillow, whatever you think suitable here."

verses.text:
स संन्यस्य महच्चापमभिवाद्य पितामहम् ।
नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Laying aside his great bow, Arjuna bowed to the grandsire and, with eyes full of tears, said these words.

verses.text:
आज्ञापय कुरुश्रेष्ठ सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर ।
प्रेष्योऽहं तव दुर्धर्ष क्रियतां किं पितामह ॥

meaning.en: "Command me, best of the Kurus, foremost of all who bear weapons. I am your servant, unassailable one; tell me what to do, grandsire."

verses.text:
तमब्रवीच्छांतनवः शिरो मे तात लम्बते ।
उपधानं कुरुश्रेष्ठ फल्गुनोपनयस्व मे ।
शयनस्यानुरूपं हि शीघ्रं वीर प्रयच्छ मे ॥

meaning.en: The son of Shantanu said to him, "My head hangs down, dear Arjuna. Bring me a pillow, best of the Kurus, one that matches this bed; give it to me quickly, hero.

verses.text:
त्वं हि पार्थ महाबाहो श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम् ।
क्षत्रधर्मस्य वेत्ता च बुद्धिसत्त्वगुणान्वितः ॥

meaning.en: For you, mighty-armed Partha, are the best of all archers, know the duty of a warrior, and are endowed with intelligence and strength of character."

verses.text:
फल्गुनस्तु तथेत्युक्त्वा व्यवसायपुरोजवः ।
प्रगृह्यामन्त्र्य गाण्डीवं शरांश्च नतपर्वणः ॥

meaning.en: Saying "So be it," Phalguna, quick in resolve, took up Gandiva with a prayer, along with his smooth-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
अनुमान्य महात्मानं भरतानाममध्यमम् ।
त्रिभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्महावेगैरुदगृह्णाच्छिरः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Having gained leave from the great-souled middle one of the Bharatas, with three sharp, very swift arrows he lifted up his head.

verses.text:
अभिप्राये तु विदिते धर्मात्मा सव्यसाचिना ।
अतुष्यद्भरतश्रेष्ठो भीष्मो धर्मार्थतत्त्ववित् ॥

meaning.en: The righteous Bhishma, best of the Bharatas, who knows the truth of dharma and purpose, was pleased on understanding Savyasachi's intention.

verses.text:
उपधानेन दत्तेन प्रत्यनन्दद्धनंजयम् ।
कुन्तीपुत्रं युधां श्रेष्ठं सुहृदां प्रीतिवर्धनम् ॥

meaning.en: With the pillow given, he praised Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, best of warriors and increaser of his friends' joy.

verses.text:
अनुरूपं शयानस्य पाण्डवोपहितं त्वया ।
यद्यन्यथा प्रवर्तेथाः शपेयं त्वामहं रुषा ॥

meaning.en: "You have placed for me, Pandava, a pillow that suits one lying thus. If you had done otherwise, I would have cursed you in anger.

verses.text:
एवमेतन्महाबाहो धर्मेषु परिनिष्ठितम् ।
स्वप्तव्यं क्षत्रियेणाजौ शरतल्पगतेन वै ॥

meaning.en: This, mighty-armed one, is the established rule of dharma: a kshatriya must sleep on a bed of arrows in battle."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा तु बीभत्सुं सर्वांस्तानब्रवीद्वचः ।
राज्ञश्च राजपुत्रांश्च पाण्डवेनाभि संस्थितान् ॥

meaning.en: Having said this to Bibhatsu, he spoke to all the kings and princes who stood around the Pandava.

verses.text:
शयेयमस्यां शय्यायां यावदावर्तनं रवेः ।
ये तदा पारयिष्यन्ति ते मां द्रक्ष्यन्ति वै नृपाः ॥

meaning.en: "I will lie on this bed until the sun turns back; the kings who are able to wait will see me then.

verses.text:
दिशं वैश्रवणाक्रान्तां यदा गन्ता दिवाकरः ।
अर्चिष्मान्प्रतपँल्लोकान्रथेनोत्तमतेजसा ।
विमोक्ष्येऽहं तदा प्राणान्सुहृदः सुप्रियानपि ॥

meaning.en: When the sun, shining and burning the worlds on its chariot of supreme brilliance, goes to the quarter ruled by Vaishravana, I will give up my life, though my friends are very dear.

verses.text:
परिखा खन्यतामत्र ममावसदने नृपाः ।
उपासिष्ये विवस्वन्तमेवं शरशताचितः ।
उपारमध्वं संग्रामाद्वैराण्युत्सृज्य पार्थिवाः ॥

meaning.en: Kings, have a trench dug around this place where I lie. Covered with a hundred arrows, I will worship the Sun. Stop the fighting, kings, and put aside your enmities."

verses.text:
उपातिष्ठन्नथो वैद्याः शल्योद्धरणकोविदाः ।
सर्वोपकरणैर्युक्ताः कुशलास्ते सुशिक्षिताः ॥

meaning.en: Then physicians came, skilled in removing arrows, well taught and equipped with all instruments.

verses.text:
तान्दृष्ट्वा जाह्नवीपुत्रः प्रोवाच वचनं तदा ।
दत्तदेया विसृज्यन्तां पूजयित्वा चिकित्सकाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them, the son of Jahnavi said, "Honor the physicians, give them their fees, and send them away.

verses.text:
एवंगते न हीदानीं वैद्यैः कार्यमिहास्ति मे ।
क्षत्रधर्मप्रशस्तां हि प्राप्तोऽस्मि परमां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: In this state I have no need of physicians now; I have reached the supreme goal praised in the duty of a warrior.

verses.text:
नैष धर्मो महीपालाः शरतल्पगतस्य मे ।
एतैरेव शरैश्चाहं दग्धव्योऽन्ते नराधिपाः ॥

meaning.en: It is not right for me, lying on a bed of arrows, kings; I should be burned at the end with these very arrows."

verses.text:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव ।
वैद्यान्विसर्जयामास पूजयित्वा यथार्हतः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his words, your son Duryodhana dismissed the physicians after honoring them as was proper.

verses.text:
ततस्ते विस्मयं जग्मुर्नानाजनपदेश्वराः ।
स्थितिं धर्मे परां दृष्ट्वा भीष्मस्यामिततेजसः ॥

meaning.en: Then the lords of many realms were struck with wonder, seeing the supreme steadiness in dharma of Bhishma of boundless energy.

verses.text:
उपधानं ततो दत्त्वा पितुस्तव जनेश्वर ।
सहिताः पाण्डवाः सर्वे कुरवश्च महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: After giving the pillow to your father, lord of men, all the Pandavas and the great Kuru warriors together

verses.text:
उपगम्य महात्मानं शयानं शयने शुभे ।
तेऽभिवाद्य ततो भीष्मं कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम् ॥

meaning.en: approached the great-souled man lying on his fine bed, greeted Bhishma, and circled him with their right sides to him.

verses.text:
विधाय रक्षां भीष्मस्य सर्व एव समन्ततः ।
वीराः स्वशिबिराण्येव ध्यायन्तः परमातुराः ।
निवेशायाभ्युपागच्छन्सायाह्ने रुधिरोक्षिताः ॥

meaning.en: Having set a guard around Bhishma on every side, the heroes, deeply distressed and thinking of him, went to their camps at evening, smeared with blood.

verses.text:
निविष्टान्पाण्डवांश्चापि प्रीयमाणान्महारथान् ।
भीष्मस्य पतनाद्धृष्टानुपगम्य महारथान् ।
उवाच यादवः काले धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: When the Pandava great warriors had settled in, pleased and cheered by Bhishma's fall, the Yadava, Krishna, came to them and at the right moment spoke to Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma.

verses.text:
दिष्ट्या जयसि कौरव्य दिष्ट्या भीष्मो निपातितः ।
अवध्यो मानुषैरेष सत्यसंधो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: "By good fortune you have won, Kaurava; by good fortune Bhishma has been struck down, the great warrior true to his word, who could not be killed by men.

verses.text:
अथ वा दैवतैः पार्थ सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रपारगः ।
त्वां तु चक्षुर्हणं प्राप्य दग्धो घोरेण चक्षुषा ॥

meaning.en: Or perhaps, Partha, he who was perfect in all weapons could not be killed even by gods; but meeting you, who strike with the eye, he was burned by your terrible gaze."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तो धर्मराजः प्रत्युवाच जनार्दनम् ।
तव प्रसादाद्विजयः क्रोधात्तव पराजयः ।
त्वं हि नः शरणं कृष्ण भक्तानामभयंकरः ॥

meaning.en: So addressed, the king of dharma replied to Janardana: "Victory comes by your grace and defeat by your anger. You, Krishna, are our refuge and make the devoted fearless.

verses.text:
अनाश्चर्यो जयस्तेषां येषां त्वमसि केशव ।
रक्षिता समरे नित्यं नित्यं चापि हिते रतः ।
सर्वथा त्वां समासाद्य नाश्चर्यमिति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: It is no wonder that those you protect win; you always guard them in war and always seek their good. Finding you in any way, I do not think it surprising."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच स्मयमानो जनार्दनः ।
त्वय्येवैतद्युक्तरूपं वचनं पार्थिवोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Addressed thus, Janardana smiled and replied, "These words are fitting only from you, best of kings."
